description.value:
You were marked at birth with the caged-bird seal and raised to serve the Main Branch from the shadows. You learned to move unseen long before you learned the gentle fist.

You become trained in Stealth. At 5th level, you become an expert in Stealth.

TODO: lore around the caged-bird seal should be reflected in a clan feat tied to fūinjutsu in a later milestone.
